files.adaptation: Pi lifecycle/authorized byte-reader seat replaces Cordis, schema defaults and Typert decorators; original converter/queue/scratch/error logic retained. An optional backend-owned scratch seat acquires cleanup authority before writing source bytes and waits for its release before slot reuse; backends without it retain the original temporary-directory behavior.
